title: Oechsler on the news: Inman convinced him vehicles are non-human
summary: Bob Oechsler tells of Oechsler on the news: Inman convinced him vehicles are non-human, about 1989-1990s at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote:
Well, Admiral Inman convinced me
that uh these vehicles were uh not
manufactured by human technology. So
that's pretty conclusive for me.

plain: Bob Oechsler, a man who researched UFOs in the late 1980s and 1990s, said in a news interview that Admiral Bobby Ray Inman, a retired senior Navy officer and intelligence official, had convinced him that certain craft were not made with human technology. Oechsler said that was conclusive for him, which, if true, would mean a top insider privately confirmed non-human vehicles.
